about: Where and when a conference met, for the route on the Year page. `match` is a case-insensitive regular expression tested against the venue shown on the Google Scholar profile, which may be cut short with an ellipsis; sister venues and workshops with similar names are excluded. A paper whose venue and year are not listed here is counted but left off the route; add an edition to put it there. The page looks back on one year, so only that year's editions are listed. WWW 2026 was moved from April to 29 June - 3 July and kept Dubai as its listed venue.

series.name: AAAI
series.match: ^(?!.*(International AAAI|AAAI/ACM|Web and Social Media|AI, Ethics|Human Computation|Interactive Digital|Symposium|Workshop (on|at|of)\b|Workshops\b)).*\bAAAI\b

series.name: ACL
series.match: ^(?!.*(Transactions|Injury|Chapter|Workshop (on|at|of)\b|Workshops\b)).*(\bACL\b|Annual Meeting of the As(?!sociation of)(?!soc\.)(?!sociation for (?!Comp|…|\.\.\.)))

series.name: SIGIR
series.match: ^(?!.*(Forum|Asia Pacific|Annual International|Human Information|Theory of Information|Innovative Concepts|Workshop (on|at|of)\b|Workshops\b)).*(\bSIGIR\b(?![- ]AP)|Research and Development in Information Retrieval)
